pull_request.title: doc: add scroll margin to links
pull_request.body: Before: Opening a section link like [this one](https://nodejs.org/docs/latest/api/os.html#oscpus) would hide the section title behind the sticky stability header: After: Page scroll is offset by 50px so the section header is visible: The value change is undone below 600px where it is not an issue because the page header is not sticky.
